content_name: QA How Long Does a Flooring Installation Take

actions.caption:
How long does a flooring installation actually take? Days, not weeks.

Typical main floor:
• Vinyl plank / laminate: 1 to 2 days
• Hardwood: 2 to 4 days
• Staircase: add about a day

What extends it: removing the old floor, levelling the subfloor, moving furniture. All of it gets planned in the quote, so there are no surprises mid-job. And some floors need a day or two to acclimate in your home first. We build that into the schedule.

Want the exact timeline for your space? Free in-home quote, link in bio.
